rm_moons_night.title: Night on Mars
rm_moons_night.contextNote: The photograph shows sunset, not the two moons mentioned in the fact.

rm_dust_2018.title: Dust on Mars
rm_dust_2018.contextNote: The photo shows a local dust devil. The 2018 planet-wide storm described by the fact was a separate event.

rm_soil_water.title: Water and Martian soil
rm_soil_water.contextNote: The photo shows drilling, not exposed ice. Nearby ice in the mission is a game simplification.

rm_leak.title: Finding leaks in space
rm_leak.contextNote: This is space-station leak detection, not our fictional Mars air leak. RELL detects ammonia leaks; it does not patch them.

rm_cold.title: Frost on Mars
rm_cold.contextNote: The frost image is from Utopia Planitia. Do not label it as the location or time of a Gale Crater temperature measurement.

rm_solar_event.title: Watching the Sun
rm_solar_event.contextNote: Use the frozen mission snapshot for observed event/class, observation date and source status. The saved photo is separate from that input. Never describe its flare as the current observation.
